title: Unit Event — Competitive Fire! — Episode6 A Nagging Feeling

meta.Event Outline: When Vivid BAD SQUAD go for a meal with Ken, Taiga and the twins before their return to Japan, an unexpected reunion sparks a newfound fire in An.

rows.Line: Several dozen minutes later
New York City - Park

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow...! This place is huge!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's such a beautiful park...!

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Hehe.
The weather's really nice, so it's the perfect time to talk about our little show!

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: The locals have picnics and stuff here a lot.

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line: Why don't we grab some grub at the food trucks and munch while we talk?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sure. How does that patch of grass sound?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, that looks good. It even has benches.
Let's go claim them now, shall we?
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Slade
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's so nice to get direct feedback like this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You learn so much when you can get an objective view on your own music.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Anyway, it's our turn next! How did we do, you guys?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, well... First, I think we were all surprised by that bold key change in the intro.

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah, that track was pretty wild... Or rather, it was very “Elena”.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Hehe. You're gonna make me blush, praising me like that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Does Elena write all the songs for illys?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'll help arrange things from time to time, but she does most of the work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was such an amazing song!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That street performance you did was really powerful, but the way you sang this time was—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Umm...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You two were really amazing.
I got goosebumps right at the start of the first song.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't think I'll ever forget hearing it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: But?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry, this isn't really a criticism or anything...
But something felt different compared to that street performance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How do I put it...? It sounded like you two were in pain.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I did it again...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: I know that I have to switch gears when I take the stage, but it still shows when I sing.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: Sorry, I wish I could've covered for you a little better...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: It's just... I wasn't expecting to see him there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: I think it's going to be impossible to avoid him, if you're joining the tournament.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean by that...?

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: This seems like a good time to tell you all...

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line: If you're all going to compete, then you're bound to find out sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Rebecca
rows.Line:
So, Vivid BAD SQUAD...
We'd like to tell you this directly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds like a complicated situation...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is this something to do with RUSH BEATS?

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
The thing is, our dad...
He's one of the sponsors for RUSH BEATS.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: A big one at that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: For RUSH BEATS...?

rows.Speaker: Cedric
rows.Line: Yeah. And just last year, they got a big-name sponsor on board.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, Cedric did mention something about that...)

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: When you're competing at RUSH BEATS, you're probably gonna hear all sorts of rumors...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: Some true, some not true and everything in between...

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line: So, before you're exposed to them, we need to tell you the real story ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Elena
rows.Line:
Would you mind listening for a bit?
About us and our dad, DG...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Elena...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, please tell us.
